title: What's New: Business Central Integration with Power Platform including Power BI(2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Job Queue Features and Copilot Support
Power BI New Content and Reports
Power BI AL Code and Developer Experience
Power BI Multilanguage Support and Connector Improvements

features.name: Linked Environment Support
features.description: Power Automate now honors linked environments defined in tenant admin Center, with an assisted setup page to configure or change the linked environment for Business Central integration.

features.name: Find One Record Action
features.description: A new Power Automate action that allows pinpointing a specific record in Business Central using friendly search criteria.

features.name: Find Records Action
features.description: An action in Power Automate that allows finding a selection of records and iterating on them within a flow.

features.name: Job Queue Business Event and Templates
features.description: A new business event and set of Power Automate templates will be available allowing users to be notified when something is wrong with job queues.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have added a new um business event and a set of power automate templates that will be available for you later

features.name: Power Automate New Designer Support
features.description: Power Automate now comes with a new designer that allows using copilot within Power Automate to build flows, now fully enabled for Business Central with support for our triggers.

features.name: Copilot-Assisted Flow Building in Business Central
features.description: A feature allowing users to build flows using copilot inside Business Central, complementing the Power Automate capability, currently not ready.
features.status_evidence_quote: it will be also possible within business Central it's just this feature is still not ready will be coming later this wave

features.name: Copilot Studio Connector for Business Central
features.description: Integration between Business Central and Copilot Studio enabling data access, actions, and plugins from Business Central to be available in Copilot Studio for building custom copilot experiences and chatbots.

features.name: Copilot Studio Generative AI Mode
features.description: A new mode in Copilot Studio that uses generative AI to determine copilot behavior based on English descriptions, eliminating the need to manually define each topic and flow.

features.name: Power BI New Content Apps
features.description: New apps in preview containing more than 60 different report pages covering the most used areas inside Business Central, available out-of-the-box since the first minor update.
features.status_evidence_quote: since the first minor update you will actually have access to some new apps in preview which contain a lot more than 60 actually
caveats: available from first minor update onwards

features.name: Power BI Embedded Reports with Full Capabilities
features.description: Enhanced embed experience for Power BI reports in Business Central allowing developers to embed reports with rich context including filter panes, bookmarks, and multiple report pages with full filtering and drilling capabilities.

features.name: Power BI Report Page Bookmarking
features.description: Simplified bookmarking of Power BI report pages within Business Central, making it easier to return to specific pages from the home bar.

features.name: Power BI Report Page Search
features.description: Power BI report pages are now searchable within Business Central, allowing users to find pages through the search functionality.

features.name: Power BI Multilanguage Support
features.description: Multilanguage experience for Power BI reports allowing developers to specify language preferences when embedding reports, with translations baked at platform level within the Power BI report itself.
features.status_evidence_quote: now not all of the labels are translated we are still working on this so that's why it's upcoming for a minor release

features.name: Power BI Add-in in System Application
features.description: The Power BI add-in is now included in the system application, allowing apps to make direct use of it without requiring separate setup.

features.name: Power BI Code Generator
features.description: A code generator available in the BCGh repo or online that takes an Excel file and generates AL pages for embedding Power BI reports, simplifying extension maintenance for ISVs.

features.name: Power BI Connector Refresh Options
features.description: New options added to the Power BI connector allowing report creators to customize connection refresh behavior and specify custom timeouts for OData queries.
caveats: defaults already set to recommended values
